purpose: Discovery shortlist for audio-to-brightness learning from dance; not an approved training manifest.
evidence_limit: Public channel identities, indexed video titles/descriptions and creator pages checked. Full videos were not visually audited in this search. Camera stability, clean single-subject intervals, tracking and audio synchronization remain unverified. Rankings and lighting relevance are research judgments.

channels.name: Poppin John SBK
channels.seek: Solo practice and uninterrupted solo performances.
channels.value: Potential examples of sharply articulated attacks, isolated movement, stops and recovery.
channels.screen: Partner videos, moving cameras, tutorial speech; apparent slow motion must be checked for actual editing.

channels.name: takeSomeCrime
channels.seek: Forsythe solo room performances, starting with Catgroove and Booty Swing.
channels.value: Potential counterweight to attack-heavy popping: groove, syncopation and sustained phrase movement.
channels.screen: Older resolution, dark clothing, body clipping, outtakes and edited endings.

channels.name: Jardy Santiago
channels.seek: Full-speed solo freestyle and complete musical demonstrations.
channels.value: Potential examples of continuous groove and rhythmic variation without a flash on every hit.
channels.screen: Talking, counts, step repetition without expressive phrasing, foot cropping, replacement audio.

channels.name: Dytto
channels.seek: Full-body solo performances and practice sessions.
channels.value: Potential examples of fine articulation and contrast between fluid and abrupt gestures.
channels.screen: Finger-only closeups are poorly matched to a body skeleton; stage edits, partners and camera movement.

channels.name: Official World of Dance
channels.seek: Solo FRONTROW / BACKROW uploads, especially Fik-Shun and Dytto.
channels.value: Artist diversity and complete performance phrases.
channels.screen: Series label is not a fixed-camera guarantee; check pans, zooms, cuts, spectators and live audio.
queries: World of Dance FRONTROW solo Fik-Shun

channels.name: URBAN DANCE CAMP
channels.seek: An instructor alone in a continuous wide shot, not the whole class.
channels.value: Expand choreographic vocabulary and musical styles after the simple solo extraction works.
channels.screen: Group sections, repeated routines and moving camera; title Solo Dance may be a song name, not performer count.

channels.name: Kyla Bullings
channels.seek: Solo/instructor passages with stable framing, starting with the existing raingurl reference.
channels.value: Keep the user-selected taste reference represented while testing new technical sources.
channels.screen: Do not presume the whole class video is single-subject; isolate clear passages.

channels.name: Millennium Dance Complex Los Angeles
channels.seek: Choreographer-alone passages and stable wide recordings.
channels.value: Broader movement styles and existing Tom Ford taste anchor.
channels.screen: Groups, moving cameras, dancer overlap, crowd reactions, repeated groups performing the same routine.

channels.name: MARQUESE SCOTT
channels.seek: Solo full-body freestyle; older continuous outdoor or practice takes.
channels.value: Potential examples of accents, freezes, slow motion, and continuous movement within one passage.
channels.screen: Camera pans, edited time effects, collaborations, feet leaving frame.
channels.selection_note: Deprioritized following explicit user feedback; Pumped Up Kicks is not a positive taste anchor.

taste_update.user_preference: More like Poppin John SBK and Catgroove; less like viral trends such as Pumped Up Kicks.
taste_update.interpretation: Prioritize controlled popping, isolation and sustained rhythmic groove. Popularity is not a selection criterion; evaluate the movement and musical response.
